written: 2026-11-21, after SeedLM-27, before any SeedLM-28 coder was trained
question: Is SeedLM-27's development lead real? At 80 minutes the paraphrase coder solved 61 development tasks alone and the control 58, with one seed per arm
arms: the same two arms with seeds 2 and 3: s28-c2, s28-p2, s28-c3, s28-p3 (scripts/seedlm4_train.py --minutes 80 --d-model 320 --layers 8 --heads 10 --views 3 --seed <seed> --variant-share 0.1, with --paraphrases for the p arm). Nothing else runs while they train
primary_measure: development fifth (94), the coder alone at 80 minutes (first verified program at beam width 32, SeedLM-15's cache): paraphrase minus control, mean over seeds 1, 2, 3 (seed 1 is SeedLM-27's pair, +3). Supported if at least +3; not supported if at most 0; inconclusive otherwise
secondary_measures: held-out teacher tasks at 80 minutes, the same difference (seed 1: +2)
the system on the development fifth with each paraphrase coder (scripts/seedlm4_tasks.py holdout; best method against 69)
choice: diagnostic; the system's adoption rule is unchanged

outcome.primary: development fifth at 80 minutes, paraphrase minus control: seed 1 +3 (61 vs 58), seed 2 -2 (55 vs 57), seed 3 +7 (61 vs 54); mean +2.67, between 0 and +3: inconclusive
secondary: held-out teacher tasks at 80 minutes: +2 (53 vs 51), +2 (61 vs 59), -2 (56 vs 58); mean +0.67
the system on the development fifth: best method 68 (s27-p), 67 (s28-p2), 67 (s28-p3), against 69 with s5-var
outcome.reported: the paraphrase coders alone average 59.0 development tasks against 56.3 for the controls; two of three reach 61, the most any post-coder has solved alone
outcome.reading: Reading the real training tasks in three wordings may help a coder read real development tasks, by about two to three tasks out of 94 on average, with seed-to-seed swings as large as the effect. It does not reach the system: the extra tasks it solves are ones the engine already solves
outcome.choice: no new method; next: whether these coders are more independent voters in the ensemble (SeedLM-29)
